messages:
mira_sec: Heads-up: compliance asked for a short runbook and rollout plan for per-repo KMS keys + admission verification. Need quick decisions on RBAC, Rekor retention, and CVE gating.
ivan_infra: I can own the KMS templates. Proposal: one cryptoKey per repo, build SA gets roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner on that key, ops group gets a read-only audit role.
zoe_ci: CI changes: generate key (cosign KMS), produce SBOM (syft), cosign attest+sign, push image, then emit audit event. Sample snippet I plan to add:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key kms://projects/ret/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/repo-key gcr.io/redwood/repo@sha256:...
syft packages --output json > sbom.json
curl -X POST https://logger-audit-prod.internal/events -d '{"repo":"repo","commit":"$COMMIT","image":"sha256:...","signer":"repo-key","rekor":123}'
```
frank_sre: Rekor retention: 6 months hot, monthly cold-archive to GCS with 2y immutable retention. Admission webhook: verify cosign signature + Rekor inclusion id -> allow. If missing -> quarantine label + notify infra.
qa-bot: vuln-scan: base-image-202402 flagged openssl CVE-2024-0001 severity: high. Auto-failed one recent build.
mira_sec: CVE policy: fail builds on critical/high in base layers. Create expedited rebuild pipeline and a small canary rollout (10% traffic for 24h).
ivan_infra: IAM template ready. Will attach to ticket INFRA-10111. Also recommend per-repo key rotation schedule (90d) and emergency revoke play documented.
zoe_ci: I'll file INFRA-10112 for CI steps + example Rekor payloads. ETA tomorrow.
frank_sre: Runbook owners? mira_sec + frank_sre to draft key-compromise play: revoke key, mark images signed by key as suspect, trigger rebuilds, update admission webhook to block, notify customers.
mira_sec: I'll draft and circulate today. Meeting in 20 to finalize. If you can't attend, paste notes here. :thumbsup:
